items.title: A Trip to London
items.summary: Omar has an exciting adventure in London, exploring famous places and trying delicious food.
items.body: Last spring, Omar travelled to London for the first time. He took the early train and arrived at ten o'clock. First, he visited the British Museum and saw the old Egyptian stones. After that, he walked along the river and took many photos of Big Ben. The weather was rainy, but he did not care. In the evening, he ate fish and chips in a small restaurant near the hotel. On the second day, he rode the big wheel by the river and saw the whole city from the top. When he came home, he told his family everything. It was the best trip of his life.

items.title: Learning English Online

items.body: Five years ago, learning a language meant buying expensive books and sitting in a classroom. Today, everything changed. With a phone and a little time, anyone can learn English at home. Layla watches short videos on the bus, reads simple articles before bed, and speaks with a friend once a week on a free call. She makes mistakes, but she does not stop. After one year of small daily steps, she can understand films without subtitles. Her secret is not talent. It is twenty minutes every day, even when she feels tired.

Next Saturday, he is going to take the driving test. He is nervous because he wants to pass. When he gets his license, he will be able to drive to his friend's house. He will not need to ask his parents for rides anymore. Tom is excited about his future as a driver.

items.title: My Big Exam
items.summary: Write about your plans for a big exam coming up soon.
items.body:
Write about your plans for a big exam next month. Think about what you will do to prepare and how you will feel when it is finished.

I have a big English exam next month. I am going to study every evening after dinner. I am going to review all my vocabulary and grammar rules. When the exam comes, I will be ready. I will not be nervous because I will prepare well. After the exam, I will celebrate with my friends. I will feel proud of myself for working hard.

items.title: Saving Money
items.summary: How to save money for something special you want.
items.body: Saving money for something special is a good habit. Many people save money for things they want. When you save money, you put a little bit away regularly. You are going to save $10 every week. When you have enough money, you will buy what you want. Saving teaches patience and planning. When you see your money grow, you will feel good about your future. You can save for a trip, a new phone, or something else important to you.

words.def: The money you keep instead of spending it

items.title: Rainy Day Plans
items.summary: Tom checks the weather forecast and changes his plans for Saturday.
items.body: Tom is going to have a picnic in the park on Saturday. He is looking forward to it. On Friday evening, he checks the weather forecast. It says it will rain all day on Saturday. Tom is sad. He doesn't want to sit in the rain. Then he has an idea. 'I will visit the museum instead,' he thinks. 'It will be warm and dry there.' The museum has a new exhibition about dinosaurs. Tom calls his friend. 'We are going to the museum on Saturday,' he says. 'It will be fun!'

items.title: Future Dreams
items.summary: Two friends talk about their unusual ambitions.
items.body:
Anna: What are you going to do after school, Ben?
Ben: I'm going to travel the world. I will visit many countries.
Anna: That sounds exciting! Where will you go first?
Ben: I will go to Japan. I want to see Mount Fuji.
Anna: That's a great plan! What are you going to study in university?
Ben: I'm not sure yet. Maybe I will study photography.
Anna: Oh! I will be a famous singer one day.
Ben: Really? That's amazing! When will you start singing?
Anna: Next year! I will sing at the school talent show.

items.title: The Strange Noise
items.summary: Tom hears a mysterious sound in his house one night and investigates.
items.body: Last night, I was sleeping when I heard a strange noise. It was coming from the kitchen. I was walking slowly toward the kitchen when my cat jumped out from behind the door. She was playing with a toy mouse. I was laughing when I realized it was just my cat. She was making that noise all along! I was feeling relieved and went back to bed.

items.title: Meeting a Celebrity
items.summary: Two friends talk about meeting a famous actor at a coffee shop.
items.body:
Anna: I was walking to work yesterday when I saw Tom Cruise at a coffee shop.
Liam: Really? What was he doing?
Anna: He was sitting alone and drinking coffee. I was feeling very nervous but I asked for a photo.
Liam: Did he say yes?
Anna: Yes! He was very nice. He was smiling and talking to me for five minutes.
Liam: That's amazing! Have you told anyone else?
Anna: Yes, I've told all my friends and family. They can't believe it!

items.title: The Best Meal Ever
items.summary: A food writer describes the most memorable meal of her life.
items.body: I have eaten many delicious meals in my life, but one stands out. It happened last summer in Italy. I was walking through a small town when I smelled something wonderful. I followed my nose to a family restaurant. The owner, Maria, was cooking pasta. She saw me and invited me to eat with her family. We were sitting outside when the sun was setting. Maria made fresh pasta with tomatoes from her garden. I have never tasted anything so good before. That meal taught me that the best food is made with love.

items.title: The Broken Window
items.summary: A young boy tells about a mistake that led to an unexpected friendship.
items.body: Last Saturday, I was playing soccer in the park with my friend Jake. I was kicking the ball very hard when it suddenly flew toward a house. I wasn't looking where I was going. The ball broke a small window in the old house. I felt terrible and ran to hide. Then an old man came out. He wasn't angry. He said, 'I've been wanting to fix that window for years. Thank you!' He invited us inside for cookies and lemonade. We've visited him every weekend since then. He tells us wonderful stories about when he was young.

items.title: A Lucky Find
items.summary: Write about a time when you found something valuable or important by chance.
items.body:
Write about a time when you found something valuable or important by chance.

Last week, I was walking home when I noticed something shiny on the ground. I was looking at my phone, so I almost missed it. It was a wallet with some money and an ID card. I was checking the address when the owner came back. She was very happy and gave me a small reward. I felt good because I could help her.

items.title: A Kind Stranger
items.summary: Read about how a kind stranger helped someone in need.
items.body: Many people have stories about kind strangers helping them. Last month, Sarah was at the airport when she realized she had lost her passport. She was looking everywhere when a man approached her. He worked at the airport and had found it. He was checking the details when Sarah's flight was announced. He helped her quickly, and she caught her flight. Small acts of kindness can make a big difference in someone's day.

items.body: Tom has always wanted to learn new things. Last year, he started playing the guitar. He practiced every day, and now he can play three songs. He has already performed for his family. Last month, he tried cooking a new recipe. He has made it twice, but he hasn't tried it yet with his friends. Next week, he wants to learn another skill. He has already joined a photography class. items.title: A Memory That Stays
items.summary: Two friends share a special memory from their childhood.
items.body:
Anna: I was thinking about our school days yesterday. What were you doing when you heard about the big storm?
Tom: I was walking home from the library. The rain was starting to fall when I saw you running toward me.
Anna: That's right! You were holding that book about dinosaurs. I was so scared of the storm, but you made me laugh.
Tom: Those were good times. I have always remembered that day. We have been friends for so long!
Anna: I know. I have kept that book you gave me all these years.
